summary: Separate English and Arabic discovery identified ESA and an Egyptian public-services land-survey procedure, but no anonymous Sidfa parcel ID plus geometry response was verified.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Fetched; confirms ESA survey/mapping remit and lists services, but no parcel feature endpoint or schema.
Fetched; links to paper, digital and historical maps and surveying services only.
Fetched; Arabic page requires a customer request specifying location, scale, layers, format and projection, followed by review/payment. No anonymous parcel API, schema, CRS or geometry exposed.

custodianAssessment.nationalAgency: Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA), evidenced at https://www.esa.gov.eg/
custodianAssessment.reason: No Sidfa municipal/governorate public registry or parcel service was evidenced. ESA is recorded as national survey/cadastral custodian only, not as a city-specific integration.

geometry.reason: No bounded native parcel geometry response was available from a public source.

scopeLimits: No city boundary or complete Sidfa coverage was established.
The exact WUP point [26.9777312751515, 31.409472351581] was preserved and no exact-point hit/miss was used as an absence claim.

uncertainty: High: a national official cadastral/map custodian is evidenced, but public parcel access, local scope, schema, CRS, stable native identity and geometry remain unverified.
completion: Research packet complete for attempt 1 of 3; runtime qualification remains held pending independent serial review of a real adapter/source.
